## History

Mary was widowed when her son [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) was a baby and has been chronically ill almost ever since. Facing her own death, she reached out regarding the future of her twin children, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and [Dora](../character/dora.md). Her cousin, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), agreed to take in the twins after being persuaded by [Anne](../character/anne.md).
